title: Lesson 49 · The end of a dream

examples.en: Teheran is the capital of Iran.
The young man lived in Teheran.
examples.zh: 这个年轻人住在德黑兰。

examples.en: He was tired of sleeping on the floor.
I feel tired after a long walk.
examples.zh: 走了很长的路后我感到很疲倦。

examples.en: He saved up for years to buy a real bed.
examples.zh: 他攒了好几年的钱买一张真正的床。

examples.en: This is a real diamond.
He became the proud owner of a bed.
examples.zh: 他自豪地拥有了一张床。

examples.en: Who is the owner of this shop?
The bed had springs and a mattress.
He was still on the mattress.
The mattress was carried into the house.
A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof.
examples.zh: 一阵狂风把床刮下了屋顶。

examples.en: The wind swept the bed off the roof.
Please sweep the floor.
The bed fell into the courtyard below.
examples.zh: 床掉到了下面的院子里。

examples.en: The children are playing in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 孩子们正在院子里玩耍。

examples.en: The bed was smashed to pieces.
He smashed the window with a stone.
The man was miraculously unhurt.
examples.zh: 这个人奇迹般地没有受伤。

examples.en: The man was unhurt after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后这个人没有受伤。

examples.en: He glanced at the broken bed.
She glanced at her watch.
He promptly went to sleep again.
She answered the question promptly.
A storm blew up on the third night.
examples.zh: 第三天夜里刮起了风暴。

examples.en: The wind is blowing hard.

sentences.en: The weather was very hot, so he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
sentences.zh: 天气很热，于是他把床搬到了屋顶上。

sentences.en: He slept very well for the first two nights.
sentences.zh: 头两个晚上他睡得非常好。

sentences.en: On the third night, a storm blew up.
sentences.zh: 第三天夜里刮起了风暴。

sentences.en: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof and sent it crashing into the courtyard below.
sentences.zh: 一阵狂风把床刮下屋顶，让它摔到了下面的院子里。

sentences.en: The bed struck the ground and was smashed to pieces, but the man was miraculously unhurt.
sentences.zh: 床撞到地面摔成了碎片，但这个人却奇迹般地没有受伤。

sentences.en: He sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house.
sentences.zh: 他伤心地捡起床垫，把它搬进了屋里。

article.en: Tired of sleeping on the floor, a young man in Teheran saved up for years to buy a real bed.
article.zh: 一位德黑兰的年轻人厌倦了睡地板，攒了好几年的钱买了一张真正的床。

article.en: For the first time in his life, he became the proud owner of a bed with springs and a mattress.
article.zh: 他有生以来第一次自豪地拥有了一张带弹簧和床垫的床。

article.en: The weather was very hot, so he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
article.zh: 天气很热，于是他把床搬到了屋顶上。

article.en: He slept very well for the first two nights.
article.zh: 头两个晚上他睡得非常好。

article.en: On the third night, a storm blew up.
article.zh: 第三天夜里刮起了风暴。

article.en: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof and sent it crashing into the courtyard below.
article.zh: 一阵狂风把床刮下屋顶，让它摔到了下面的院子里。

article.en: The bed struck the ground and was smashed to pieces, but the man was miraculously unhurt.
article.zh: 床撞到地面摔成了碎片，但这个人却奇迹般地没有受伤。

article.en: He sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house.
article.zh: 他伤心地捡起床垫，把它搬进了屋里。

article.en: After he had put it on the floor, he promptly went to sleep again.
article.zh: 把它放到地板上后，他又立刻睡着了。
